thresholds.note: Absolute audit recommendations, not DEC-070 preregistered numeric thresholds; no cross-sectional sample quantiles are used.

formulae.adtv_proxy_bounds: sum(volume_t * low_t) <= true daily quote volume <= sum(volume_t * high_t)
formulae.jump_return: r_t = ln(close_t / close_t-1), only when timestamps differ by 4H

adtv.source_schema_issue: All current CSVs contain base volume but omit the original Binance quote asset volume column.

missing_fields: historical total or max supply and/or fully diluted valuation
float_market_cap_ratio.definition_gap: DEC-070 must freeze whether the ratio means market_cap/FDV, circulating_supply/total_supply, or circulating_supply/max_supply.
float_market_cap_ratio.estimated_acquisition_cost: 1-3 engineering days for 35-ID mapping, cutoff-aligned snapshots, missing-value reconciliation, and audit storage; a paid API tier may be required.

oi_market_cap_ratio.constraint: Binance openInterestHist exposes only the latest one month, so it cannot recover the 2020-2024 audit history in 2026.
oi_market_cap_ratio.estimated_acquisition_cost: 2-5 engineering days plus any historical-data vendor cost for archived OI, symbol mapping, venue-scope decisions, and timestamp alignment.
oi_market_cap_ratio.non_equivalent_proxy: Recent OI notional / recent ADTV can monitor near-term crowding, but it does not replace historical OI / market cap.
